subject: Live acceptance: minimal smoke plan & KV priming steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com, Acme Ops <acme_ops@acme.com>
Cc: EdgeCloud Support <support@edgecloud.io>
Date: 2026-12-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Live acceptance: minimal smoke plan & KV priming steps

Team / Acme,

We are scheduled to flip traffic from the pre-prod VPC to the live VPC today. This thread is to confirm the minimal acceptance (smoke) plan, who owns each step, and to make sure KV cache priming (warmup) happens before traffic cutover. Key constraints: keep the maintenance window to <= 30 minutes, avoid rolling restarts, and preserve client affinity for the first 10m of traffic.

Summary / ask:
- Confirm 12:30-13:00 PST maintenance window (proposed below).
- Karthik, please validate the KV warmup sequence and the priming keys we agreed on.
- Marissa/Sean, please own observability checks and traffic steering fallback.
- Acme Ops: confirm firewall exceptions and that your observers will watch the 5xx and 429 spike windows.

Minimal acceptance criteria (must pass to mark go-live):
1) New VPC accepts control-plane connections and model endpoints respond to health probes (200/OK) for 5 consecutive probes (30s cadence).
2) Latency P50 for short completion (<=512 tokens) remains within 10% of baseline.
3) No more than 2 sustained 5xx/min across the fleet during the 10m post-cutover ramp.
4) KV cache hit-rate >= 60% after warmup phase.

KV warmup plan (high level):
- Step A (priming): run the attached kv-warmup-checklist.md to seed the top 10k prefix keys (script uses --parallel=16). Estimated runtime: 8-12 minutes.
- Step B (validation): run smoke-test-cases.xlsx -> smoke/kv-sanity to validate hits, sample responses, and token counts.
- Step C (monitoring): confirm cache hit-rate in the console and trace a sample request end-to-end.

Attachments:
- kv-warmup-checklist.md (script + flags)
- smoke-test-cases.xlsx (cases for both control-plane and model endpoints)

Proposed timeline (PST):
- 12:00: Final go/no-go (ops bridge open)
- 12:05: Start KV warmup (Step A)
- 12:20: Validation run (Step B)
- 12:30: Traffic cutover window begins (ramp 0->100% over 5 minutes)
- 12:40: Observe and validate for 10 minutes; fallback decision by 12:50

If anything looks off, we will fallback to the pre-prod route and re-run warmup in a targeted manner.

Runbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-cutover-runbook
Jira: INFRA-9421

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: kv-warmup-checklist.md (text/markdown)]

Subject: Re: Live acceptance: minimal smoke plan & KV priming steps

Mina — thanks, good plan. A couple of inline notes: 

> - Step A (priming): run the attached kv-warmup-checklist.md to seed the top 10k prefix keys (script uses --parallel=16). Estimated runtime: 8-12 minutes.

I recommend we reduce --parallel to 8 for the first run (network + storage IO are a bit spiky in this region); if metrics look healthy at 8 we can bump to 16 for remaining keys. That keeps the risk profile lower.

> - Step B (validation): run smoke-test-cases.xlsx -> smoke/kv-sanity to validate hits, sample responses, and token counts.

I'll add a quick validation script (kv-validate.sh) to the checklist that reports: total seeded keys, cache hit-rate, 95th pct CPU for model workers, and a sample payload trace ID list (first 100).

Network note: make sure EdgeCloud opens ephemeral egress to 18.205.0.0/16 (this is the telemetry sink) otherwise our observability will lag and we won't be able to validate within the window.

I can be on the bridge and will run the validation script.

-Karthik
Lead Infra Eng

Mina / team,

We can take the 12:30-13:00 PST window as requested. A few items from our side: 
- Firewall exceptions: we've opened the following source ranges for the window (confirmed): 52.14.0.0/16, 18.205.0.0/16.
- Observers: two of our SREs will be on the bridge (Lara & Jon) and will watch 5xx/429 dashboards as well as the control-plane health probes.
- We recommend a 20-minute warmup window (12:00-12:20) instead of 8-12 minutes so we can seed keys and run the first validation pass without rushing. If you can stagger the priming (parallel=8 for first 10k, then scale) that fits our ops profile.

We'll also mirror a small percentage (1%) of traffic for a 5-minute pre-cutover sanity check if you want — we'd rather mirror than send live traffic initially. Let us know if you want that enabled; we can flip it on at 12:25.

Thanks,
Roman Patel
Acme Ops

- 12:05: KV warmup start (Karthik; parallel=8 for first pass)
- 12:20: Validation pass (Karthik + Marissa)

- 12:30: Traffic ramp begins (Gradual 0->100% over 5 minutes, Sean owns steering)
